facts.value: DVDGetDriveStatus is classified into indices0..5 or sentinel-1. For an active display, saved language chooses jp_msg or us_msg and the current index selects three string pointers. facts.rationale: State exact index domain, sentinel meaning, final callback ordering or pointer lifetime using pinned canonical evidence.

facts.rationale: Retain source-level string behavior without asserting physical pooling.

facts.value: Classifies drive status, enters audio/rumble bracketing, allocates and configures lb_804D63D0, selects jp_msg/us_msg by saved language, and builds three centered/kerned text lines. Changed indices refresh the strings. Each iteration invalidates GX caches, renders text, requests asynchronous XFB copy, invokes a non-null callback and only then tests the exit sentinel. Cleanup destroys the text object and writes gmMainLib_8046B0F0.xC = true.
facts.rationale: State exact index domain, sentinel meaning, final callback ordering or pointer lifetime using pinned canonical evidence.

facts.value: Runs a blocking localized DVD-status display only for initial message indices 0 through4. It configures a three-line Japanese or U.S. text object, renders and optionally calls cb each iteration, and polls for status changes. Index5 can appear during the loop but cannot open it. A -1 classifier result causes one final render/callback before cleanup; -1 means an unmapped status, not a proof of successful media recovery.
facts.rationale: State exact index domain, sentinel meaning, final callback ordering or pointer lifetime using pinned canonical evidence.

facts.value: Only initial indices0..4 allocate the modal display. Changed nonnegative indices replace all three lines; index5 is allowed while active. A polled -1 is observed at the next loop iteration, which skips text replacement, renders existing text, requests XFB copy and invokes cb before breaking. Cleanup calls audio restoration, clears rumble suppression, destroys the text object and sets gmMainLib_8046B0F0.xC true. The stored text pointer is not reset.
facts.rationale: State exact index domain, sentinel meaning, final callback ordering or pointer lifetime using pinned canonical evidence.
